qualification_scope: llm_agent control plane plus pinned agent-dev-kit component
purpose: Separate product M5 qualification from long-term asset terminal qualification without weakening fail-closed evidence semantics.

maintainer_model.policy: Solo maintenance is an explicit operating model, not a waiver of automated governance, recovery, portability, or evidence requirements.

llm_agent.policy: The root repository is an operational control-plane workspace; durable component releases belong to versioned components such as agent-dev-kit.

agent_dev_kit.note: ADK native governance, strict stale-base rejection/requalification, exact-head merge, fresh-main qualification, keyless GitHub OIDC promotion, branch GC, and issue closure are terminally complete. This removes ADK governance as an internal dependency blocker but does not satisfy LTA-02 real-provider evidence or LTA-04 real-time evidence.

qualification_layers.note: Representative runtime evidence is sufficient for Product M5 but long-term terminal portability requires R2 real-provider substitution evidence below.

blocking_requirements.name: native-repository-governance
blocking_requirements.acceptance: A native repository ruleset covers main, requires pull requests, preserves the solo-maintainer zero-approval policy, has no unconditional bypass actors, permits squash merges only, requires the canonical stable PR qualification contexts with strict/up-to-date status enforcement, blocks destructive/non-fast-forward main updates, and delegates ordinary merged-PR branch deletion to native delete-on-merge while custom Branch GC is restricted to explicit exact-SHA retirement proofs.
completed_subrequirements: merged PR branch deletion observed before custom GC deletion
generic merged-PR custom GC responsibility retired

blocking_requirements.name: multi-runtime-portability
blocking_requirements.acceptance: R2 only: at least two healthy real runtime/provider bindings complete the same controlled real task under one exact Digital Worker governance identity with exact ADK release/source-set/distribution identity, separate execution receipts, and independent machine-verifiable domain verification/review under one shared frozen task and verifier/reviewer standard. Fake or controlled alternate bindings may prove R1 contract conformance but cannot satisfy LTA-02.

blocking_requirements.name: solo-maintainer-recovery-drill
blocking_requirements.acceptance: A clean environment reconstructs the control plane from authoritative source, verifies current identities, exercises rollback/recovery, and emits a machine-readable receipt without relying on untracked local state.

blocking_requirements.name: longitudinal-operation
blocking_requirements.acceptance: At least 30 days of independent pilot observation are summarized with incidents, regressions, recovery events, and unresolved risks represented explicitly. Zero observed incidents/regressions/recoveries are valid only when represented explicitly; blocking unresolved risks or a review hold keep qualification blocked.

terminal_readiness.meaning: The engineering/control-plane implementation and both terminal paths are proven reachable by fail-closed rehearsal, while all internal cross-repository dependencies including agent-dev-kit governance/promotion are terminally closed; real long-term qualification remains blocked only until LTA-02 real external evidence and LTA-04 real time evidence satisfy the canonical certifiers.
